INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
INFRASTRUCTURE
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act to amend the Infrastructure Development Authority
of the Punjab Act 2016
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 29th October, 2016]
No. PAP/Legis-2(139)/2016/1491,
dated 29-10-2016.---The Infrastructure Development Authority of
the Punjab (Amendment) Bill 2016, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab on October 19, 2016, and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on October 28, 2016, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the
Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab Act 2016 (IV of 2016) to
omit succession clause, and to deal with incidental purposes.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be cited as the Infrastructure Development Authority of the Punjab
(Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
